description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {1}{R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Goldspan Dragon +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
